## Fixes

- **Screenshots work on a fresh install.** On a new installation (seen on Linux) every screenshot
  failed because its folder was never created. The folder is now created when it is missing.
- A failed or stuck screenshot no longer leaves an `adb` process running in the background.

## Cleaner interface

- New app icon.
- The Window menu bar is gone. **Always on Top** is now a pin button in the toolbar.
- Command categories sit on one row, and the side menu shows its labels by default.
- Light theme: accent colours are darker so text and buttons are easier to read.
- Empty screens say what to do next.
- The Virtual Display screen was removed. It needed Android 14 and was meant for phones, not TVs.

## Updating

If you are on 1.6.2, the **Update now** banner (or Settings > Updates) installs this version on
Windows. On Linux it opens this page - download the file for your system below. Versions before
1.6.2 cannot download updates: install this version by hand once.

See the [README](https://github.com/TonciZ/QA-Adbpad#readme) for download and setup help.
